title.en: Rational means structural order, not low saturation
title.zh: 理性是結構秩序，不是低彩度

rule.en: Read 'rational / restrained' briefs as a demand for alignment, grouping and hierarchy. Colour may still be bold.
rule.zh: 客戶說「理性、克制」時，要的是對齊、群組與層級；用色仍然可以大膽。

why.en: A first draft that equated rational with off-white paper, black text and one red accent was judged 'too flat'. The order was right; the energy was missing.
why.zh: 第一版把理性等同於米白紙＋黑字＋一點紅，被判為「太平淡」。秩序對了，張力不見了。

do.en: Keep a strict grid and let colour carry the mood.
do.zh: 網格嚴格，情緒交給色彩。

dont.zh: 為了看起來「專業」把所有顏色調灰。

title.en: Tidiness is the floor, not the design

rule.en: A layout that is merely aligned is unfinished. Every first round must include at least one direction pushed too far. Never fill a page with equal-sized card grids.
rule.zh: 只做到對齊的版面還沒完成。第一輪至少要有一個方向推過頭；禁止整頁等大卡片網格。

why.en: Four separate first drafts were rejected for being too safe: 'looks like an old flyer', 'too obedient', 'like someone who just learned layout software'.
why.zh: 四份獨立的第一版都因太安全被退：「像舊 DM」「太乖」「像剛學會排版軟體的人做的」。

do.en: Deliver one stable option and one tension option side by side (see WG-08).
do.zh: 同時交一穩一張力兩個方向（見 WG-08）。

dont.en: Use a uniform card grid as the default composition.
dont.zh: 預設用等大卡片網格構圖。

rule.en: Take alignment lines from the edges of objects inside the image (a product edge, a table line, a horizon) and set text on them, so image and text share one grid.
rule.zh: 從圖中物件的邊緣（產品邊、桌線、地平線）取對齊線，讓文字落在上面，圖與文共用同一套網格。

why.en: Reference layouts chosen as 'rational yet fused' (bathroom and building-material catalogues, an architecture magazine) all aligned type to edges found in the photograph, not to an abstract column grid.
why.zh: 被選為「圖文融合又不失秩序」的參考（衛浴、建材型錄、建築雜誌）都是把字對齊到照片裡的邊，而不是抽象欄格。

do.en: Extract 3–6 candidate lines from the image, then choose (see WG-04).
do.zh: 先從圖裡抽 3～6 條候選線，再挑選（見 WG-04）。

dont.en: Use every candidate line; that scatters the page.
dont.zh: 每條候選線都用上，版面會過度分散。

rule.en: A heading and its body text are one unit. Each group takes exactly one anchor line; different groups anchor separately.
rule.zh: 標題＋內文是一個整體，整組只取一條錨點；不同組各自錨定。

why.en: When every block snapped to its nearest object line, the page became 'scattered and stiff'. Alignment lines are candidates, not orders.
why.zh: 每個區塊都吸附到最近的物件線時，版面「過度分散、很呆板」。參考線只是候選，不是命令。

do.en: Decide groups first, then assign one anchor per group.
do.zh: 先決定群組，再為每組指派一條錨線。

dont.en: Split a heading from its paragraph to hit a line.
dont.zh: 為了對到線把標題和段落拆開。

title.en: The type scale is a skeleton, not a ceiling

rule.en: Start from four levels (24 / 16–18 / 10 / 8 pt for print) as a floor. Set sizes by eye first, codify afterwards. Showcase pieces may use extreme scale, cropping and overlap.
rule.zh: 以四級（印刷 24／16～18／10／8pt）當底線。先憑感覺拉字級，做完再回頭定調。展示型作品可以用極端尺度、裁切、疊壓。

why.en: Using only four sizes everywhere 'will always look stiff'. A multi-size exhibition version was judged better than the disciplined one.
why.zh: 四個字級一直用「一定會顯得非常呆板」。多字級的參展版被判比守規矩的版本好。

do.en: Treat the scale as the minimum vocabulary.
do.zh: 把字級表當最低詞彙量。

dont.en: Use the scale to normalise a good layout into a dull one.
dont.zh: 拿字級表把好版面整理成死板。

rule.en: Design folded and multi-page pieces as the unfolded surface. At least one element should cross a fold or gutter on purpose.
rule.zh: 摺頁與多頁印刷品以攤開的整面來設計；至少一個元素刻意跨過摺線或裝訂線。

why.en: A tri-fold designed as three separate panels was called 'a pity — no cross-panel design'.
why.zh: 把三摺當成三個獨立面板做，被評「沒有跨頁的設計非常可惜」。

do.en: Sketch the open spread before the panels.

dont.en: Treat each panel as its own poster.
dont.zh: 每一面各做一張小海報。

rule.en: A portfolio piece demonstrates craft; it does not explain design. If a panel reads like a lesson, replace it with an example.
rule.zh: 作品集是在展示功力，不是在教平面設計。哪一面讀起來像講義，就換成一個實例。

why.en: Feedback: 'you are a designer showing skill, not a teacher of graphic design.'
why.zh: 回饋原話：「是要展現功力的設計師，不是要教平面設計的老師。」

do.en: Let one strong visual carry the claim.
do.zh: 讓一個強視覺扛住主張。

dont.en: Annotate your own design with explanatory captions.
dont.zh: 在自己的作品旁加解說文字。

rule.en: Present options in pairs: one that is safe to approve and one that risks something. Name your own side-effects instead of silently fixing them; the client may like them.
rule.zh: 提案成對給：一個穩、一個冒險。自己察覺的副作用要說出來讓對方選，不要默默修掉，對方可能正好喜歡。

why.en: In a practice brand the client picked the more daring logo in four of four rounds (recommendation hit rate 3/9), then picked the stable option for the card and brochure. Preference is not one-directional.
why.zh: 練習品牌中，logo 四輪都選了比推薦更大膽的（推薦命中 3/9）；名片與 DM 卻選了穩的。偏好不是單向的。

do.en: Track your recommendation hit rate per project.

dont.en: Assume bolder is always better, or safer is always better.
dont.zh: 假設越大膽越好，或越安全越好。

title.en: A logo is a concept distilled to its final form
title.zh: Logo 是把概念精煉到極致的造形

rule.en: Before drawing, write one sentence of concept and an element→meaning table (element, meaning, why this shape). If you cannot fill the table, do not draw.
rule.zh: 動筆前先寫一句概念與「元素→意義」表（元素、意義、為什麼是這個形）。表填不出來就不要畫。

why.en: 'Detail is not drawing thin lines; it is that every line, every position and every shape choice was thought through.' Parametric assemblies of circles and rectangles were judged 'lacking detail'.
why.zh: 原話：「細節不是把東西畫得很細，而是線條跟任何一個造型放的位置、為什麼是那個造型都經過設計思考。」用圓＋矩形參數拼出來的形被判為「太沒細節」。

do.en: Attach a construction diagram and the meaning table to every proposal.
do.zh: 每款提案附構成圖與意義表。

dont.en: Ship a shape whose parts you cannot justify one by one.
dont.zh: 交出說不出每個部件理由的造形。

rule.en: A mark is allowed exactly one place where something happens (an offset, a turn, a break). Everything else stays quiet.
rule.zh: 整個符號只允許一處「動」（錯位、轉折、斷開），其他地方保持安靜。

why.en: Measured decomposition of a reference mark showed a single event; marks with several events read as ripples or noise.
why.zh: 拆解量測參考作品，只有一個事件；有多個事件的版本讀起來像水波或雜訊。

do.en: Name the event in one word before refining.
do.zh: 精修前用一個詞說出那個事件。

dont.en: Add a second gesture to 'make it richer'.
dont.zh: 為了「豐富一點」加第二個動作。

title.en: Circles decide contours; gaps take the module
title.zh: 輪廓由圓決定，間隙取模數

rule.en: Construction circles govern the visible edge, not the centre line. Let U = stroke width; gaps and radii take multiples of U/2. No automatic round caps: end strokes flat, angled or with a deliberate round.
rule.zh: 構成圓管的是看得到的邊，不是中心線。令 U＝筆寬，間隙與半徑只取 ½U 的倍數。收尾不加自動圓頭：平切、斜切或刻意的圓切。

why.en: 'The lines don't actually sit on those circles' and 'the endings aren't crisp' were both caught by eye before any measurement.
why.zh: 「線條根本沒對上那些圖形」「收尾沒有俐落感」都是先被肉眼看出來的。

do.en: Compute coordinates; never place by eye.

dont.en: Mix arbitrary gaps (2.9 next to a 12 stroke).
dont.zh: 各處各算間隙（筆寬 12 旁邊放 2.9）。

rule.en: A shape built from raw circles and rectangles can be exact and still crude. Refinement needs proportion studies, curve-tension tuning and side-by-side comparison with references of known quality.
rule.zh: 直接用圓與矩形拼出的形，就算每條邊都在圓上仍可能粗糙。精緻需要比例研究、曲線張力調整，並與已知水準的參考並排比較。

why.en: A tombstone-shaped body over an arc-shaped mound passed every geometric check and was rejected as 'too crude'.
why.zh: 墓碑形身體加圓弧土丘通過所有幾何檢查，仍被判「這個造型太粗糙了」。

do.en: Compare against the reference library before showing anyone.
do.zh: 給人看之前先跟參考庫並排。

dont.en: Treat passing automated checks as approval.
dont.zh: 把通過自動檢查當成通過審美。

title.en: Consistent within a class, different between classes

rule.en: Use at least 2–3 radius levels and a rhythm of weights. Strokes of the same class share width and angle set. Stripes are never equal-width; derive widths from a function and the count from the minimum size.
rule.zh: 半徑至少 2～3 級、粗細有節奏；同一類筆畫共用線寬與角度組。條紋禁止等粗，寬度照函數變化，條數依最小尺寸決定。

why.en: Canonical marks (the AT&T globe, IBM's 13→8 stripes, the Twitter bird's circle system) follow this; uniform parts read as clip-art.
why.zh: 典範作品（AT&T 地球、IBM 13→8 條、Twitter 鳥的圓系統）都如此；元件全一樣會像素材庫圖。

do.en: List part classes and give each its own parameters.
do.zh: 列出元件類別，每類一組參數。

dont.en: Give every element the same radius.

rule.en: Position each band from the previous one: next top = previous edge + fixed gap + half own weight, computed point by point. Whitespace is not what is left after drawing.
rule.zh: 下一條的位置＝上一條的邊＋固定留白＋自己粗細的一半，逐點計算。留白不是畫完剩下的東西。

why.en: Hand-placed gaps varied by 2.6 units; rule-generated gaps varied by ≤0.5 and the imbalance disappeared.
why.zh: 手放的留白誤差達 2.6；改用規則生成後 ≤0.5，不平衡感消失。

do.en: Measure gap variance and report it.

dont.en: Eyeball the gaps between parallel strokes.
dont.zh: 目測平行筆畫間的距離。

title.en: Answer the strategy switches before drawing
title.zh: 動筆前先回答策略開關

rule.en: New brand → simpler, mid-low complexity. Stable/quality personality → symmetry; exciting/innovative → asymmetry allowed. Soft attributes → curves; hard attributes → angles. Trust industries → never truncate the wordmark.
rule.zh: 新品牌→從簡、精緻度中偏低；穩定／品質→對稱，刺激／創新→可不對稱；軟屬性→曲線，硬屬性→角形；信任型行業→字標不可殘缺。

why.en: These map to experimental findings on logo complexity, symmetry, shape and incompleteness.
why.zh: 對應 logo 複雜度、對稱、形狀與殘缺的實驗研究。

do.en: Write the answers down and let them constrain the sketches.
do.zh: 把答案寫下來，讓它約束草圖。

dont.en: Choose symmetry or curvature by taste alone.
dont.zh: 只憑喜好決定對不對稱、曲或直。

principles.origin: van Grinsven & Das 2016; Bajaj & Bond 2018; Luffarelli et al. 2019; Jiang et al. 2016; Hagtvedt 2011

rule.en: A white gap either runs to the frame edge or ends in a full-width cut parallel to the event. A black shape ends at the frame or a clear cut, never in a sliver.
rule.zh: 白縫要嘛連到框邊，要嘛用與事件平行的全寬切口收掉；黑形結束在框邊或明確切口，從不收成尖片。

why.en: Gaps that stopped mid-shape made the mark read 'in pieces'.
why.zh: 在形中間停住的白縫，讓符號讀起來「一段一段」。

dont.en: Let a gap taper to a point.

title.en: Let image models imagine; let reasoning rebuild
title.zh: 想像交給生圖，重建交給推理

rule.en: For agents: use an image model for divergent sketches and a human for selection; then decompose the chosen sketch, rebuild it as clean vector geometry, and verify it with code. Do not draw concept sketches with parametric geometry.
rule.zh: 給 agent：發散草圖交給生圖模型、挑選交給人；選中後拆解結構、重建成乾淨向量、用程式驗收。不要用參數幾何直接畫概念草圖。

why.en: Twenty-three rounds of parametric sketching never reached the target quality; the split workflow did.
why.zh: 參數幾何畫草圖 23 輪都沒達到水準；分工後才達到。

do.en: Keep the original sketch's character during rebuild.

dont.en: Auto-trace, or 'correct' the sketch into your own rules.
dont.zh: 自動描圖，或用自己的規則把原稿「修正」掉。

title.en: Automate correctness; leave preference to people
title.zh: 正確性自動化，偏好交給人

rule.en: Print specs, bleed, minimum type size, legal wording and 'did the AI alter the product photo' must be checked by code, because a client cannot see them on screen. Liking or not liking is the client's call.
rule.zh: 印刷規範、出血、最小字級、法規用字、產品圖有沒有被 AI 改，都要程式檢查，因為客戶在螢幕上看不出來。喜不喜歡由客戶決定。

why.en: Errors that pass screen review appear only after printing; every escaped error becomes a new automated check.
why.zh: 螢幕上看不出的錯，印出來才出現；每抓到一個逃逸錯誤就補一條檢查。

do.en: Only promise what you have measured.

dont.en: Ask the client to proofread technical specs.
dont.zh: 讓客戶去校對技術規格。
